title: Fake Moon totem
description: totem of undying with fake moon album cover by cleopatrick, also replaces pop sound with lyric "You want the city for yourself" from "BAD GUY" track!
body:
This custom resource pack completely changes the Totem of Undying for all cleopatrick fans out there! It replaces the default vanilla totem texture with the iconic album cover art from "Fake Moon". 

Additionally, it customizes the game audio by replacing the standard totem pop sound with the  lyric "You want the city for yourself" from the track "BAD GUY"! Works perfectly on latest versions. I hope you'll Enjoy!
